description.value: Running Room is a Canadian running-specialty chain carrying running footwear, performance apparel, and training accessories for men and women. The North Vancouver location is part of a national network founded on the philosophy of helping everyday runners improve. A touring cyclist might find nutrition products, socks, or moisture-wicking apparel here, but no cycling-specific services are offered.
